### subst-date | kinds=read,read | flags=
echo $(date)

### subst-pct | kinds=read,read | flags= | inner=pct:103
echo $(pct exec 103 -- hostname)

### subst-nested-write | kinds=write,write,write | flags=
echo $(echo $(rm -rf /tmp/synthetic-dir))

### subst-backtick | kinds=read,read | flags=
echo `hostname`

### assignment-then-echo | kinds=read,unknown,read | flags=
x=$(date); echo $x

### subst-command | kinds=read,unknown | flags=
$(which ls)

### assign-prefix | kinds=write | flags=
FOO=bar systemctl restart nginx
